# Ringworld audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/ringworld-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set ringworld` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `wind.mp3` is cut from "Wind in grass, recording close to the ground, with gust of wind, bird and insect singing, cars passing sometimes, a plane far away" by felix.blume, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/felix.blume/sounds/665640/.
